seasonalTasks.title: Remove fruited floricanes
seasonalTasks.body: Prune out fruited canes to ground after harvest; train current-year primocanes to wires.

seasonalTasks.title: Tip primocanes at 4 ft
seasonalTasks.body: Encourages lateral branching for next year's crop.

seasonalTasks.title: Blackberry harvest
seasonalTasks.body: Pick fully black + dull (not glossy). Glossy = not ripe.

notes: Thornless semi-erect blackberry. Hardy to -10 °F; trellis at 4 ft + 6 ft wires.
